label: RSS: On New Entry
description: Fires once per new entry in an RSS or Atom feed. No account needed; activation starts from now (history never replays) and the position survives restarts.

inputs.name: intervalSecs
inputs.label: Check every (seconds)
inputs.description: How often the feed is checked.

outputs.name: entry
outputs.description: The whole parsed entry (id, title, link, summary, published, author).
